title: UI风格#64 - Ancient Egyptian (古埃及神秘)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian style When color palette Then features gold, lapis blue, black, sand, terracotta
Given Ancient Egyptian style When typography Then uses ancient fonts: Cinzel, UnifrakturMaguntia, or Almendra
Given Ancient Egyptian style When layout Then pyramid motifs, hieroglyph borders, desert dunes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: hieroglyph background text (Egyptian unicode chars), gradient dunes overlay, gold border with ☥ ankh symbol, Eye of Horus divider

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian style When UI elements Then gold accents, ankh symbols, stone textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gold borders and icons, ankh ☥ ornament, hieroglyph Unicode (𓂀𓃀𓇋 etc), Egyptian agent names (Ramesses/Nefertiti/Cleopatra/Imhotep)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian UI When functional Then includes temple chat, pharaoh agents, obelisk stats
